name: berth-plugin-pi
description: The Pi coding agent for berth machines.

features.label: Pi
features.description: The Pi coding agent, from npm. The version is `devbox_pi_version` in the profile's ansible_vars.
features.summary: Pi (`pi`). It signs in from inside the program, or takes API keys from the environment.

actions.name: update
actions.label: Update Pi
actions.help: Bring Pi to its latest version from npm. Part of Update. The version in the profile is the least one; a newer one stays when the configuration is applied again.
actions.run: echo; echo '── Pi'; npm install --global --prefix "$HOME/.local" --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel error --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@latest && pi --version
